The last customer is 'cobalt'. I need to get their net balance.

I have successfully retrieved the net balance for all three customers: acme (29089 cents), birch (62075 cents), and cobalt (50341 cents). Now I must record a payout for each customer with their respective net balance. I will record them one by one.
